local_renewal.rule: Target first, second-middle persistent root second.
local_renewal.conclusion: Each certified double is funded; target rises by>=1 until H; once full, persistent output>=1. Target warmup takes<=ceil(H) steps.
local_renewal.full_profile: At six full banks, continuing five outputs stay H and retired first-middle receives H-1.
local_renewal.limitation: Arbitrary interruptions must preserve entry conditions; universal entry is not assumed.

packet_identity.recurrence: D_next=max(0,D+q-r), D=H-target; each genuine access starts D=0.
packet_identity.all_paid_iff: Every within-access contiguous packet has sum(q-r)<=H, using actual clipped-trajectory other-bank stocks.
packet_identity.sharing: r is existing transferred stock, never new A issuance.
